quests.title: Tile a single row
quests.ask: In a plaza one row long, put a gem on your starting cell and on every other cell after it, with no two gems side by side.
quests.nudge: The robot can't see the floor. What can it remember about the cell it just left?

quests.title: Carry the pattern round the corner
quests.ask: In a plaza two rows tall, put a gem on your starting cell and lay the chessboard: no two gems touch across or up and down.
quests.nudge: Stepping down to the next row is a step to a new cell, just like stepping along a row.

quests.title: Rows of odd length
quests.ask: In a plaza with an odd number of columns, lay the chessboard on every row: no two gems touch across or up and down.
quests.nudge: Does each row start the same way here? Look at the cell above each row's first cell.
